question: cobramos más comisión a los comercios de riesgo
sql: SELECT merchant_sk, trade_name, risk_tier, settlement_currency, fee_minor, interchange_minor, scheme_fee_minor, gross_eur_minor, net_eur_minor FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN dim_merchant ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_id = dim_merchant.merchant_id WHERE dim_merchant.is_current = 1 AND dim_merchant.risk_tier IS NOT NULL GROUP BY merchant_sk, trade_name, risk_tier, settlement_currency, fee_minor, interchange_minor, scheme_fee_minor, gross_eur_minor, net_eur_minor ORDER BY gross_eur_minor DESC
